title: Department of Energy: DOE FY 2025 Consolidated Audit Management Letter
publisher: Department of Energy Office of Inspector General
summary: The management letter reported 33 cybersecurity findings, including 13 repeat findings, during the FY 2025 consolidated financial-statement audit. Phase 56E entity use: DOE's later records show continuing FISMA and access-control work alongside a bounded 2026 statutory determination that the reviewed sharing requirements were implemented.
key_findings: Access-control weaknesses were reported as a significant deficiency.
Entity layer: DOE unclassified cybersecurity program.
Compatibility boundary: Same department but different audit objectives, tested controls, and denominators.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: A financial-audit management letter is not the same measurement system as an annual FISMA evaluation.
Independent DOE OIG records; statutory implementation and general program effectiveness remain distinct.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
